title: Descent of a bivariant class along an envelope from the equality of its two restrictions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is a descent statement for bivariant classes: given c' on X' -> Y' over an envelope Y' -> Y whose two restrictions to X' times_X X' coincide, one must produce a unique c on X -> Y restricting to c' (statement lines 6706-6718, tag 0GUC). The proof has to construct the operation itself, first on CH_k(Y) by lifting along the envelope and pushing forward, then on every locally finite type base change, and it must verify the well-definedness through the exact sequence for envelopes and the bivariant axiom h_* a_* = h_* b_*. Condition (1) of the bivariant definition is checked in full by transporting lifts along a proper morphism; the author states that the remaining two conditions are proved in the same manner and omits the details, so the claim is H2.
